name: work
description: Steady Work — tier-two employment above the job board. XP-gated. Two archetypes: SHIFTS at a venue (clock in, ride a posture-tick of timed skill-check events, keep the manager's satisfaction up or get sent home; wage flat + tips) and COURIER runs (carry a real, keepable parcel across the map before a deadline; clean/sketchy on the board, hot from a fence; crack the seal to steal the contents and burn the run).
